The gods and angels dwelt in Heaven.
Demons gathered in the Netherworld.

The demons invaded Heaven, igniting
Ragnarok, the war of gods and demons.

As the war grew ever more savage,
the world sank into deepest chaos...

Evil gods and demons overwhelmed
Heaven, leaving it on the brink of ruin.

At last, the gods broke their own taboo,
sacrificing their lives and wisdom...

to create black-winged Grim Angels,
whose blades would herald destruction.

With Diviners imbued with divine might,
the Grim Angels flew into battle...

The Grim Angels fought a brutal war,
but their deeds at last brought peace.

The demons were sealed in their realm,
but the gods, too, were doomed to perish.

On Riviera, an isle at Heaven's edge,
they left all their power and wisdom.

They entrusted it to faithful spirits,
a promised land for the gods' return.

With the gods gone, a thousand years
passed in silence...

Signs of the demons' return to Riviera
turned ages of peace into turmoil.

With the gods gone, another Ragnarok
would surely bring Heaven to its end.

The Seven Sages, the gods' deputies,
staked Heaven's fate on one decision.

To unleash the gods' power in Riviera:
the Ark of Ruin, which erases all...

To carry out their plan, the Seven
Sages chose agents worthy of the task.

heirs to the divine weapons, Diviners,
black-winged angels of destruction...

The Grim Angels, born anew,
a thousand years after Ragnarok.
Now, upon the land of Riviera...
